coverage_definition: Supported means source records were acquired, ingested, located and evaluated. An address on a map alone is not valuation coverage.

markets.limits: Block/type identities only; private housing and exact unit history not covered; coordinates from a pinned OneMap-derived mirror.
Mutation values may cover multiple parcels/lots; allocation and residential filtering required; incomplete departmental coverage.
Residential price-paid data need area/characteristics and geocoding joins; not all UK jurisdictions.
Five boroughs only; non-market/zero-price transfers, tax lots, condo units and area reliability need screening.
Buildings and addresses provide discovery, not verified transaction prices or ownership.
